title: 3432. Count Partitions with Even Sum Difference

examples.explanation: The 4 partitions are: [10], [10, 3, 7, 6] with a sum difference of 10 - 26 = -16, which is even. [10, 10], [3, 7, 6] with a sum difference of 20 - 16 = 4, which is even. [10, 10, 3], [7, 6] with a sum difference of 23 - 13 = 10, which is even. [10, 10, 3, 7], [6] with a sum difference of 30 - 6 = 24, which is even.
No partition results in an even sum difference.
All partitions result in an even sum difference.
